description: This file defines the SmartyBC class, a backward compatibility wrapper for the Smarty template engine, providing deprecated method wrappers and extending the Smarty class.

classes.name: SmartyBC
classes.description: A backward compatibility wrapper class for Smarty, providing deprecated method wrappers and extending the Smarty class.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new SmartyBC object by calling the parent constructor.

methods.name: assign_by_ref
methods.description: Wrapper for Smarty::assignByRef, assigns a referenced value to a template variable.

methods.name: append_by_ref
methods.description: Wrapper for Smarty::appendByRef, appends a referenced value to a template variable.

methods.name: clear_assign
methods.description: Wrapper for Smarty::clearAssign, clears a template variable.

methods.name: register_function
methods.description: Registers a custom function for use in templates via Smarty::registerPlugin.

methods.name: unregister_function
methods.description: Unregisters a custom function from templates.

methods.name: register_object
methods.description: Registers an object for use in templates via Smarty::registerObject.

methods.name: register_block
methods.description: Registers a block function for templates.

methods.name: register_resource
methods.description: Registers a resource for fetching templates.

methods.name: clear_cache
methods.description: Clears cache for a specific template.

methods.name: is_cached
methods.description: Checks if a cached version exists for a template.

methods.name: clear_compiled_tpl
methods.description: Clears the compiled version of a template.

methods.name: get_registered_object
methods.description: Returns a reference to a registered object.
